items.q: "the Modernaires". But in this group there was a trumpet player named Roger Guerin

ctx.x: "the Modernaires". But in this group there was a trumpet player named Roger Guerin who was the best modern trumpetist in France. He didn't play with the "Double Six" but was singing with them to my surprise.

Back to the Trois Maillets, in and out, doing galas in nearly every corner of France, concerts which had taken me to Denmark, Sweden, Belgium and a month's contract in the club "Storyville" in Frankfurt, Germany.
